title: Text mining and machine learning guide Eu-activated phosphor wavelength prediction
summary: A literature text-mining pipeline extracted phosphor/emission examples for model development; four Eu2+-activated candidates were synthesized and characterized. In the author manuscript, CaGd2S4:Eu2+ emitted at 440 nm versus 451 nm predicted under 365 nm excitation. Formula Li2SiN2 in one abstract conflicts with Li2SiN3 in results; this record does not claim that candidate formula.
ai_technology: Literature text-mining pipeline; genetic-algorithm feature selection; ML wavelength regression

evidence.tested: Author manuscript reports synthesized and measured CaGd2S4:Eu2+ and three other candidates; specific comparison retained.
evidence.unknown: One formula conflict is unresolved; author manuscript/date/version details and composition-level prior art not fully checked.
evidence.ai_role: Text mining builds experimental training set; ML predicts emission wavelength and guides candidate selection.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
